subject: [PATCH v2 03/10] mm/madvise: use the PMD softleaf validity helper

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch replaces a custom check in the mm/madvise code with the pmd_is_valid_softleaf() helper function, which is a central definition of valid PMD softleaf entries. The change simplifies the code and ensures consistency with the kernel's internal definitions. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
